# INDUSTRYAI – Digitale Lösungen für Unternehmen

> INDUSTRYAI develops professional websites, custom apps, recruiting solutions, and intelligent digital processes for companies.

INDUSTRYAI creates digital solutions that fit a company's goals, target groups, and workflows. The public website is organized around five areas: Leistungen, Musterprojekte, Ratgeber, Recruiting-Check, and Über uns.

## Core Areas

- [Home](https://industryai-solutions.de/) — Interactive campus homepage with five clickable buildings.
- [Leistungen](https://industryai-solutions.de/leistungen.html) — Websites, web development, recruiting, custom apps, and digital processes.
- [Musterprojekte](https://industryai-solutions.de/musterprojekte.html) — Example website and app concepts across different industries.
- [Ratgeber](https://industryai-solutions.de/ratgeber.html) — Practical guidance for digital visibility, websites, apps, and recruiting.
- [Recruiting-Check](https://industryai-solutions.de/recruiting-check.html) — A short assessment of a company's digital recruiting readiness.
- [Über uns](https://industryai-solutions.de/ueber-uns.html) — INDUSTRYAI's approach, philosophy, and way of working.

## Ratgeber Articles

- [Unternehmensprofil erstellen](https://industryai-solutions.de/ratgeber-unternehmensprofil-erstellen.html) — Practical guide to creating and maintaining a Google Business Profile.
- [Individuelle App-Entwicklung](https://industryai-solutions.de/ratgeber-individuelle-app-entwicklung.html) — App types, use cases, planning, costs, and implementation.
